- ATK 159%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When activating the Active Skill or when attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK 159%{passiveImg:up_g} and DEF 158%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*When activating the Active Skill*
- ATK 159%{passiveImg:up_g} temporarily
*When there is an "Androids/Cell Saga" Category enemy or another
"Androids/Cell Saga" Category ally on the team*
- {passiveImg:once}Changes Ki Spheres: All to TEQ & STR
